about: The labels of a pattern, as CIP-05 gives them. celis writes them and every reader reads them, so both
must match this file: the CLI test writes a pattern with `celis pattern` and finds the labels of the
form with `written` on it, then puts a record of each form in the store. `celis patterns` shows each
form with `read` on it as a plain pattern, and `celis migrate` lists each other (CIP-02, "Migrate").
`labels` are the `L` and `l` tags of the record. The other tags are those of CIP-05, "Patterns".
